checks.claim: The core loop runs and completes: start, play, win and lose, restart, all reachable.
checks.evidence_required: Screenshots or a recording of win, lose and restart actually reached.
checks.how_to_run: Play the game (or drive it with browser automation) to a win, a loss and a restart.
checks.honesty_note: Never call a game playable without real evidence of win + lose + restart reached.

source.quote: Core loop runs and completes: start → play → win AND lose → restart, all reachable

checks.evidence_required: A playtest note or automated run showing pause/resume and no dead end.
checks.how_to_run: Pause and resume during play; try the known edge states.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

checks.claim: The canvas scales or letterboxes correctly at mobile and desktop sizes, and every declared input works.
checks.evidence_required: Screenshots at a mobile and a desktop viewport, and a check per declared input method.
checks.how_to_run: Screenshot at mobile and desktop sizes; exercise each input method.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Canvas scales/letterboxes correctly at mobile + desktop sizes

checks.claim: Zero console errors across a full session, and a stable delta-time loop.
checks.evidence_required: The console log of a full session with no errors.
checks.how_to_run: Capture the browser console during a full playtest.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Zero console errors across a full session

checks.claim: Listeners, timers and audio are cleaned up on restart, with no leak or double-fire.
checks.evidence_required: A restart repeated several times with no doubled events or rising listener count.
checks.how_to_run: Restart several times and watch for double-fire; read the teardown code.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

checks.claim: When a zero-dependency constraint was set, there are no external or CDN deps.
checks.evidence_required: A search of the build for external URLs and imports with no hits.
checks.how_to_run: Search the shipped files for http(s) script/style sources and package imports.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: If a zero-dependency constraint was set, no external/CDN deps

checks.claim: Save/load or high-scores, when promised, persist and restore across reloads.
checks.evidence_required: A save, a reload, and the restored state.
checks.how_to_run: Save, reload the page, and compare.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Save/load / high-scores (if promised) persist and restore across reloads.

checks.evidence_required: The screenshots or recording themselves, referenced by path.
checks.honesty_note: No Godot toolchain: mark export and clean-run NOT_RUN.

source.quote: Real playtest evidence attached (screenshots/recording of win + lose + restart)

hard_gates.gate: Honour a zero-dependency constraint when set (no CDN pulls; CSP-safe as an artifact).

source.quote: honour a zero-dependency constraint when set (no CDN pulls; CSP-safe as an artifact).

not_applicable_when: game-zero-dep does not apply when no zero-dependency constraint was set.
game-persistence does not apply when save/load or high-scores are not promised.
game-viewport-input mobile sizes do not apply when the game explicitly declares desktop-only (forge-game Domain gates).
